title: How Effective Are NPM Malicious Package Detectors? A Large-Scale Empirical Study
abstract: arXiv:2603.27549v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The NPM ecosystem faces escalating threats from malicious packages that exploit its open publication model. While numerous detection tools have been proposed, they are evaluated on disparate datasets with inconsistent settings, making cross-tool comparison unreliable and leaving practitioners without clear guidance. We present the first large-scale empirical study of NPM malicious package detection, evaluating 11 tools with 16 variants on a unified benchmark of 6,420 malicious and 7,288 benign packages annotated with 11 behavior categories and 8 evasion techniques. Unlike prior work, we inspect each tool's source code to explain why tools succeed or fail, not merely how often. Our key findings: (1) the precision and recall a tool achieves are structurally determined by how it resolves the ambiguity between code capability and malicious intent, with IntelGuard reaching the best F1 at 95.98% by grounding its judgment in retrieved evide

translated_title: NPM恶意包检测器的有效性如何？一项大规模实证研究
translated_abstract: NPM生态系统正面临利用其开放发布模型的恶意包带来的日益加剧的威胁。尽管已提出众多检测工具，但它们是在不同数据集和不一致的设置下进行评估的，这使得跨工具比较不可靠，从业者也因此缺乏明确的指导。我们开展了首个针对NPM恶意包检测的大规模实证研究，在一个统一的基准上评估了11个工具及其16个变体，该基准包含6,420个恶意包和7,288个良性包，并标注了11种行为类别和8种规避技术。与以往工作不同，我们深入检查每个工具的源代码，以解释工具为什么成功或失败，而不仅仅是成功的频率。我们的关键发现：(1) 工具所能达到的精确率和召回率在结构上取决于它如何解决“代码能力”与“恶意意图”之间的歧义，其中IntelGuard通过将判断建立在检索到的证据之上，取得了95.98%的最佳F1分数。
tldr: 该研究首次对NPM恶意包检测工具进行大规模实证评估，发现工具的检测性能在结构上取决于其如何区分代码能力与恶意意图，其中IntelGuard通过基于检索证据进行判断取得了95.98%的最佳F1分数。
en_tdlr: This first large-scale empirical study of NPM malicious package detectors reveals that a tool's precision and recall are structurally determined by how it resolves the ambiguity between code capability and malicious intent, with IntelGuard achieving the best F1 score of 95.98% by grounding its judgment in retrieved evidence.
